Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, or related field.

- Proven experience leading or supporting successful pharmaceutical product launches.
- Experience working across Spain and Portugal strongly preferred.

- Strong strategic thinking with demonstrated ability to translate insights into measurable business outcomes.
- Experience operating successfully in fast-paced launch and growth-stage brands, guaranteeing excellence in execution.
- Proven ability to influence diverse stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams in complex environments.
- Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, prioritization and decision-making capabilities.

- Define target customers, desired behavior changes, positioning, core messages, and critical success factors.

- Translate patient, customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable recommendations and practical launch plans.

Launch readiness and execution

- Partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and facilitate decision-oriented discussions to support successful launch planning and execution.

- Collaborate with global teams to contribute local insights, shape relevant plans, and localize global assets for the local market.

- Work closely with external business partners on joint planning, execution, issue resolution, and performance review, with support from the Director, Marketing as appropriate.

- Manage agencies and vendors effectively, ensuring clear accountabilities, high-quality output, appropriate timelines, and efficient use of resources.

- Represent marketing in relevant internal and external forums and communicate recommendations with clarity and credibility, seeking alignment from the Director, Marketing on major decisions.

Customer, patient, and market insights
- Develop a deep understanding of the patient journey, customer needs, treatment pathways, and barriers to adoption.

- Lead or support market research and integrate quantitative and qualitative evidence into strategic and tactical decisions.

- Engage with field teams and relevant external stakeholders to identify evolving needs, opportunities, and risks.

- Apply a disciplined insight-to-action approach to improve strategy, execution, and customer experience.

Business planning and performance management
- Provide inputs to forecasting, business planning, and launch performance evaluation in partnership with the Director, Marketing, Finance, and relevant stakeholders.

- Develop clear assumptions, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to support high-quality business decisions.

- Manage assigned launch budgets and resources in alignment with agreed priorities and the broader marketing OPEX process.

- Use data and performance indicators to identify gaps, recommend interventions, and improve marketing effectiveness.

Compliance and operational excellence
- Ensure marketing activities comply with applicable laws, industry codes, internal policies, and review processes.

- Maintain effective meeting discipline, documentation, action tracking, and follow-through for the launch program.

- Balance speed, quality, compliance, and resource constraints in a complex and changing environment.

Team collaboration and communication
- Contribute to a collaborative and high-performing team environment by sharing knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned.

- Work closely with the Director, Marketing to obtain guidance and support on complex strategic, partnership, and organizational matters.

- Proactively provide timely updates and escalate material risks, issues, opportunities, decisions required, and support needs.

- Actively seek feedback and incorporate learnings to continuously improve marketing effectiveness and personal performance.

Qualifications

Required experience and capabilities
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

- Relevant marketing or commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or a related industry.

- Demonstrated ability to contribute to the development and execution of brand or commercialization strategy.

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

- Strong strategic thinking, analytical problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills.

- Ability to translate research and business information into actionable insights, decisions, and tactical plans.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including clear and timely communication with senior stakeholders.

- Fluency or strong business proficiency in both Japanese and English.

Preferred experience
- Experience leading or playing a significant role in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology product launch.

- Experience in specialty care, rare disease, hepatology, gastroenterology, immunology, oncology, or another complex therapeutic area.

- Experience collaborating with global teams and external business partners in a joint operating model.

You will serve as the IT Data & AI Center of Excellence (COE) lead for PDM and Tech Ops AI product/s, acting as the primary interface between PDM and Tech Ops stakeholders and IT, and shaping how AI is applied to improve knowledge management, Quality processes and decision-making for Technical Development, PD, and Quality.  Reporting to the Senior Director, Data & AI, who will oversee a portfolio of AI-enabled products, lead product owners within the PDM and Tech Ops and other domains, and guide cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions at scale.
As the IT product owner, you will own the product vision, roadmap and stakeholder engagement for AI-enabled reporting, planning and analytics use cases while understanding the technical architecture required to deliver solutions.

This position is based in Foster City, CA (hybrid‑eligible).

Key Responsibilities
- Define and lead product strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI-enabled Technical Development and Quality capabilities.

- Partner with senior PDM and Tech Ops leaders to identify high-impact AI opportunities, identify pain points, and advanced analytics opportunities, and develop compelling business cases

- Lead and mentor AI Delivery Leads, Data Scientists and Product Managers. Prioritize the product backlog based on business value, risk, technical feasibility, and alignment with enterprise data and AI strategy.

- Establish and scale product operating model for consistency in delivery.

- Translate business objectives into clear product requirements and backlog items, incorporating data architecture, platform constraints, and scalability considerations.

- Own the end‑to‑end product vision and multi‑year roadmap for a portfolio of AI-enabled capabilities for Technical Development, PD and Quality decision-support, balancing enterprise priorities, platform constraints and value realization.

- Align solutions with data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and platforms. Ensure adherence to GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and regulated SDLC process.

- Define and track success metrics such as cost reduction, productivity gains, user adoption, and satisfaction; use insights to guide continuous improvement.

- Drive change management and user adoption, including designing for user experience, stakeholder communications, training strategies, and feedback loops.

- Own the vendor and partner strategy for product support, including external development capacity and AI/LLM capabilities, in coordination with IT and Procurement.

- Identify gaps between current‑state capabilities and target‑state solutions, influencing Databricks, AWS, and data platform evolution in partnership with technical leaders.

- Ensure compliance with GxP, privacy, and data governance requirements.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to clinical development leadership, applying strong business and financial acumen to evaluate trade‑offs and recommend data‑ and AI‑driven solutions.

Key Skills & Experience
- Bachelor’s with 12+ years or Master’s/PhD with 10+ years in relevant field.

- Strong understanding of clinical development processes including trial operations and data management.

- Experience leading AI/data product portfolios and teams.

- Strong executive stakeholder engagement and influence skills.

- Ability to translate complex business problems into scalable AI solutions.

- Knowledge of AI/data platforms (AWS, Databricks).

- Experience in Agile product delivery environments.

- Strong business acumen and prioritization skills.

Differentiators
- Experience in PD, Quality systems, and understanding of CMC, manufacturing and supply chain analytics

- Experience applying AI/ML in clinical trials or development.

- Experience in GxP-regulated environments.

- Exposure to generative AI use cases.
